live_performance_high_energy.description: Aggressive, high-energy live performance with all gestures

smooth_ambient_textures.description: Slow, smooth movements for ambient soundscapes

studio_recording_balanced.description: Balanced for studio recording with moderate smoothing

maximum_precision_sequencing.description: Ultra-precise control for detailed sequencing work

experimental_all_features.description: All features enabled for exploring capabilities

minimal_basic_only.description: Minimal setup - position and pinch only

djing_reactive_control.description: Reactive control for live DJing with velocity emphasis

usage_notes.loading_presets: To load a preset, save it to 'hand_midi_config.json' or use the built-in presets (keys 1-5)
usage_notes.custom_cc_mappings: Edit cc_mappings in your config to assign different MIDI CC numbers

smoothing_guide.gesture_smoothing: Similar to position but affects pinch, palm, rotation gestures
smoothing_guide.velocity_smoothing: Lower values track rapid movements better, higher values ignore small motions

sensitivity_guide.pinch_threshold_close: Distance at which pinch = 127 MIDI value (smaller = more sensitive)
sensitivity_guide.pinch_threshold_open: Distance at which pinch = 0 MIDI value (larger = more sensitive range)
sensitivity_guide.palm_sensitivity: Multiplier for palm openness detection (>1.0 = more sensitive)
sensitivity_guide.rotation_sensitivity: Multiplier for rotation detection (>1.0 = more sensitive)

performance_tips: Start with a built-in preset (keys 1-5) that matches your use case
Use +/- and [/] keys during performance to adjust smoothing in real-time
Save your tweaked settings with 's' key to preserve them
For live use, 'performance' preset (key 1) is recommended
For recording, 'studio' preset (key 2) provides stable output
Use custom mapping areas (click-drag) to define precise control zones
Lower smoothing = more expressive but requires steadier hands
Higher smoothing = more stable but less immediate response
